2.1.5 STATUS OF FLORA OF NEPAL AND WORLD REPRESENTATION
Nepal occupies about 0.1% of the global area but harbors 3.2% of floral diversity and 1.1% of
faunal diversity. Nepal’s unique geography with its dramatic changes in elevation along north-
south transects, high variability in the physiographic and climatic conditions have resulted in
rich diversity of flora and fauna.
